tool.name: 3DTrees LAS/LAZ Standardization
tool.description: Standardize individual LAS/LAZ point cloud files

param.name: input
param.label: Point Cloud File
param.help: LAS/LAZ point cloud file to standardize. Connect a collection and Galaxy will map over each file.

param.name: min_density
param.label: Minimum Point Density
param.help: Minimum acceptable point density in points per square meter. Default: 10 pts/m²

param.name: removeable_attributes
param.label: Attributes to Remove
param.help: Space-separated list of attribute names to remove (e.g., 'Intensity UserData'). Leave empty for auto-detection.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Standardizes individual LAS/LAZ point cloud files:
1. **LAS Validation**: Runs ``las_check()`` and fixes header issues 2. **Bounding Box**: Validates and corrects header bounding box 3. **Point Density**: Checks density meets minimum threshold 4. **CRS Validation**: Verifies CRS is defined and transformable to EPSG:4978 5. **Land Check**: Confirms centroid is on land (using Natural Earth data) 6. **Format Normalization**: Downgrades Point Data Format to ≤7 for compatibility 7. **Attribute Cleanup**: Optionally removes specified attributes
**Outputs:** - Standardized ``.laz`` file - Metadata JSON with pre/post standardization info - Convex hull GeoJSON in WGS84
**Workflow Usage**
In collection-based workflows: 1. Run **3DTrees Collection Check** first to validate the collection 2. Connect collection to this tool - Galaxy maps over each file automatically 3. Use ``removeable_attributes`` from collection check for cleaner output
